There, high ground should be cultivated; low-lying lands should be avoided. These rains mature flowers and fruits. This is stated for <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>.'

body.text:
344.025. revatyāṃ grīṣmāṇāṃ paścime māse yadyatra devo pravarṣati, ekaṣaṣṭyāḍhakāni pravarṣati/
344.026. tatra niṃnāni kṛṣikartavyāni/
344.026. sthalāni parivarjayitavyāni/
344.026. ekā ca varṣā sarvasasyāni saṃpādayati/
344.027. tacca sasyaṃ mitrabāndhavā manuṣyāśca paribhuñjate/
344.027. nikṣiptaśastradaṇḍāśca rājāno bhavanti/
344.028. anudvignāśca janapadā bhavanti/
344.028. udvignāśca bhavanti/
344.028. uktaṃ revatyām//
body.translated_text: 'If the rain-god rains in <s>Revatī</s>, in the last month of summer, he rains sixty-one <s>āḍhaka</s> measures. There, low-lying lands should be cultivated; high ground should be avoided. This single rainfall matures all crops. Those crops are enjoyed by friends, kinsmen, and people. Kings put down their weapons and punishments. The countryfolk are untroubled and troubled. This is stated for <s>Revatī</s>.'

body.text:
344.030. aśvinyāṃ grīṣmāṇāṃ paścime māse yadyatra devaḥ pravarṣati, aṣṭacatvāriṃśadāḍhakāni pravarṣati/
344.031. yacca madhye varṣā bhavati, tatra niṃnāni kṛṣikartavyāni/
344.031. sthalāni parivarjayitavyāni/
344.032. ekā varṣā sarvasasyāni saṃpādayati/
344.032. bhayasamāyuktāśca janapadā bhavanti/
344.032. caurāśca prabalā bhavanti/
344.033. uktamaśvinyām//
body.translated_text: 'If the rain-god rains in <s>Aśvinī</s>, in the last month of summer, he rains forty-eight <s>āḍhaka</s> measures. In the middle of the rains, low-lying lands should be cultivated; high ground should be avoided. This single rainfall matures all crops. The countryfolk are beset with fear. Thieves become powerful. This is stated for <s>Aśvinī</s>.'

body.text:
345.001. <345>bharaṇyāṃ grīṣmāṇāṃ paścime yadyatra devaḥ pravarṣati, pūrṇamāḍhakaśataṃ pravarṣati/
345.001. tatra sthalāni kṛṣikartavyāni/
345.002. niṃnāni parivarjayitavyāni/
345.002. durbhikṣaścātra bhavati/
345.002. jarāmaraṇaṃ janānāṃ bhavati/
345.003. rājānaścātra anyonyaghātakā bhavanti/
345.003. putrapautrāṇāṃ ca kalaho bhavati/
345.004. uktaṃ bharaṇyām//
body.translated_text: 'If the rain-god rains in <s>Bharaṇī</s>, in the last month of summer, he rains a full hundred <s>āḍhaka</s> measures. There, high ground should be cultivated; low-lying lands should be avoided. Famine occurs there. Death from old age occurs among the people. Kings there become mutual slayers. Strife arises among sons and grandsons. This is stated for <s>Bharaṇī</s>.'

body.text: 345.005. ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārinnakṣatrartuvarṣādhyāyaḥ//
body.translated_text: 'This, Ho <s>Puṣkarasāri</s>, is the chapter on <s>Nakṣatra</s> Seasonal Rainfall.'

body.text:
345.006. amīṣāṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārinn aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ rāhugrahe phalavipākaṃ vyākhyāsyāmi/
345.007. kṛttikāsu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin yadi candragraho bhavati, kaliṅgamagadhānāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.008. yadi rohiṇyāṃ candragraho bhavati, prajānāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.008. yadi mṛgaśirasi candragraho bhavati, videhānāṃ janapadānāmupapīḍā bhavati rājopasevakānāṃ ca/
345.009. evamārdrāyāṃ punarvasau puṣye ca vaktavyam/
345.010. āśleṣāyām yadi candragraho bhavati, nāgānāṃ haimavatānāṃ ca pīḍā bhavati/
345.011. yadi madhāsu candragraho bhavati, gauḍikānāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.011. yadi pūrvaphalgunyāṃ somo gṛhyate, caurāṇāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.012. yadyuttaraphalgunyāṃ somo gṛhyate, avantīnāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.013. yadi hasteṣu somo gṛhyate, saurāṣṭrikāṇāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.013. yadi citrāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, pakṣiṇāṃ dvipadānāṃ ca pīḍā bhavati/
345.014. yadi svātyāṃ somo gṛhyate, sarveṣāṃ pravrajyāsamāpannānāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.015. yadi viśākhāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, audakānāṃ sattvānāmupapīḍā bhavati/
345.016. yadyanurādhāsu somo gṛhyate, vaṇijānāmupapīḍā bhavati śākaṭikānāṃ ca/
345.017. yadi jyeṣṭhāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, dauvālikānāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.017. yadi mūle somo gṛhyate, adhvagānāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.018. yadi pūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, avantīnāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.019. yadyuttarāṣāḍhāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, kāmbojakānāṃ pīḍā bhavati vāhlīkānāṃ ca/
345.019. yadyabhijiti somo gṛhyate, dakṣiṇāpathikānāṃ pīḍā bhavati tāmraparṇikānāṃ ca/
345.020. yadi śravaṇeṣu somo gṛhyate, caurāṇāṃ ghātakānāṃ copapīḍā bhavati/
345.021. yadi dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, kurupāñcālānāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.022. yadi śatabhiṣāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, maulikānāmātharvaṇikānāṃ ca pīḍā bhavati/
345.023. yadi pūrvabhādrapadāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, gāndhikānām yavanakāmbojakānāṃ ca pīḍā bhavati/
345.024. yadyuttarabhādrapadāyāṃ somo gṛhyate, gandharvāṇāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.024. yadi revatyāṃ somo gṛhyate, nāvikānāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.025. yadyaśvinyāṃ somo gṛhyate, aśvavaṇijānāṃ pīḍā bhavati/
345.025. yadi bharaṇyāṃ somo gṛhyate, bharukacchānāṃ pīḍā bhavati//
body.translated_text: 'I shall now explain to you, Ho <s>Puṣkarasāri</s>, the chapter on the ripening of fruits from the eclipse of <s>Rāhu</s> upon these twenty-eight <s>nakṣatras</s>. If a lunar eclipse occurs in <s>Kṛttikā</s>, Ho <s>Puṣkarasāri</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Kaliṅgas</s> and <s>Magadhans</s>. If a lunar eclipse occurs in <s>Rohiṇī</s>, there is affliction for the peoples. If a lunar eclipse occurs in <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Videhans</s> and for the royal attendants. Likewise for <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, and <s>Puṣya</s>, the same should be stated. If a lunar eclipse occurs in <s>Āśleṣā</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Nāgas</s> and the <s>Himālayan</s> peoples. If a lunar eclipse occurs in <s>Maghā</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Gauḍikas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Pūrvaphalgunī</s>, there is affliction for thieves. If the moon is seized in <s>Uttaraphalgunī</s>, there is affliction for the people of <s>Avantī</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Hastā</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Saurāṣṭrians</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Citrā</s>, there is affliction for two-footed birds. If the moon is seized in <s>Svātī</s>, there is affliction for all those who have taken to the ascetic life. If the moon is seized in <s>Viśākhā</s>, there is affliction for aquatic creatures. If the moon is seized in <s>Anurādhā</s>, there is affliction for merchants and cart-drivers. If the moon is seized in <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, there is affliction for gatekeepers. If the moon is seized in <s>Mūla</s>, there is affliction for travelers. If the moon is seized in <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, there is affliction for the people of <s>Avantī</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Kāmbojas</s> and <s>Bāhlīkas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Abhijit</s>, there is affliction for the southerners and the <s>Tāmraparṇikas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Śravaṇā</s>, there is affliction for thieves and killers. If the moon is seized in <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, there is affliction for the <s>Kuru-Pāñcālas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, there is affliction for herbalists and <s>Atharvanic</s> practitioners. If the moon is seized in <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>, there is affliction for perfumers, <s>Yavanas</s>, and <s>Kāmbojas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>, there is affliction for <s>Gandharvas</s>. If the moon is seized in <s>Revatī</s>, there is affliction for boatmen. If the moon is seized in <s>Aśvinī</s>, there is affliction for horse-traders. If the moon is seized in <s>Bharaṇī</s>, there is affliction for the people of <s>Bharukaccha</s>.'

body.text:
345.027. evaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārin yasminnakṣatre candragraho bhavati tasya tasya deśasya pīḍā bhavati/
345.028. ityukto rāhugrahaphalavipākādhyāyaḥ//
body.translated_text: 'Thus, Ho <s>Puṣkarasāri</s>, in whichever <s>nakṣatra</s> a lunar eclipse occurs, there is affliction for the people of that respective region. This is the chapter stated on the Ripening of the Fruits of <s>Rāhu</s>'s Eclipse.'

body.text:
345.029. pratinakṣatravaṃśaśāstre yathoktaṃ karma tacchṛṇu/
345.030. ucyamānamidaṃ vipra ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanam yathā//122//
body.translated_text: 'Now hear the prescribed activities according to the <s>nakṣatra</s>-lineage <s>śāstra</s> — this discourse of the sages being declared, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.' //122//

body.text:
345.031. ṣaṭtārāṃ kṛttikāṃ vidyādāśrayaṃ tāsu kārayet/
345.032. agnyādhānaṃ pākayajñaḥ samṛddhiprasavaśca yaḥ//122 a//
body.translated_text: 'Know that <s>Kṛttikā</s> has six stars; under it one should build a dwelling. The setting up of the sacred fire, the domestic sacrifice, and the rite of prosperity and offspring should be performed.' //122a//

body.text:
346.001. <346>sarpirviloḍayettatra gavāṃ veśma ca kārayet/
346.002. ajaiḍakāśca kretavyā gavāṃ ca vṛṣamutsṛjet//123//
body.translated_text: 'One should churn butter there and build a cow-shed. Goats and sheep should be purchased, and a bull should be released among the cows.' //123//

body.text:
346.003. aśmasāramayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ sarvamatra tu kārayet/
346.004. hiraṇyakārakarmāntamiṣvastraṃ copakārayet//124//
body.translated_text: 'All vessels made of iron should be manufactured under this. Goldsmith-work and arrow-weaponry should be fashioned.' //124//

body.text:
346.005. metṛko māpayedatra kuṭikāgniniveśanam/
346.006. pītalohitapuṣpāṇāṃ bījānyatra tu vāpayet//125//
body.translated_text: 'A surveyor should measure there the dwelling and the placement of the household fire. Seeds of yellow and red flowers should be sown there.' //125//

body.text:
346.007. gṛhaṃ ca māpayedatra tathāvāsaṃ prakalpayet/
346.008. navaṃ ca cchādayedvastraṃ krayaṇaṃ nātra kārayet//126//
body.translated_text: 'A house should be measured there; likewise a dwelling should be designed. New cloth should be covered there, but no trading should be conducted.' //126//

body.text:
346.009. krūrakarmāṇi sidhyanti yuddhasamrodhabandhanam/
346.010. parapīḍāmathātraiva vidvānnaiva prayojayet//127//
body.translated_text: 'Cruel deeds succeed — battle, siege, and imprisonment. But a wise man should never employ them for the harassment of others.' //127//

body.text:
346.011. śastrāṇi kṣurakarmāṇi sarvāṇyatra tu kārayet/
346.012. taijasāni ca bhāṇḍāni kārayecca krīṇīta ca//128//
body.translated_text: 'All weapons and razor-works should be made under this. Metal vessels should both be manufactured and purchased.' //128//

body.text:
346.013. āyuṣyaṃ ca śiraḥsnānaṃ strīṇāṃ viṣkambhaṇāni ca/
346.014. pravarṣaṇaṃ ced devasya nātra vairaṃ praśāmyati//129//
body.translated_text: 'Life-promoting head-bathing and protective rites for women should be done. If the rain-god rains, hostility is not pacified under this.' //129//

body.text:
346.015. krodhano harṣaṇaḥ śūrastejasvī sāhasapriyaḥ/
346.016. āyuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca yajñaśīlo 'tra jāyate//130// kṛttikāsu//
body.translated_text: 'One born under <s>Kṛttikā</s> is wrathful, joyous, heroic, brilliant, fond of daring deeds, long-lived, famous, and devoted to sacrifices.' //130// For <s>Kṛttikā</s>.

body.text:
346.017. sarvaṃ kṛṣipadaṃ karma rohiṇyāṃ saṃprayojayet/
346.018. kṣetravastuvihārāṃśca navaṃ veśma ca kārayet//131//
body.translated_text: 'All activities relating to agriculture should be undertaken in <s>Rohiṇī</s>. Fields, properties, monasteries, and new houses should be built.' //131//

body.text:
346.019. prayojayeccakrān vārān dāsāṃścaiva gṛhe paśūn/
346.020. vāpayetsarvabījāni dhruvaṃ vāsāṃsi kārayet//132//
body.translated_text: 'One should employ wheels, water-works, servants, and livestock in the household. One should sow all types of seeds, and garments should definitely be made.' //132//

body.text:
346.021. ṛṇaṃ na dadyāttatraiva vairamatra tu vardhate/
346.022. saṃgrāmaṃ ca surāyogaṃ dvayameva vivarjayet//133//
body.translated_text: 'One should not give loans under this; enmity increases under this. Both battle and liquor-brewing should be avoided.' //133//

body.text:
346.023. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya janma cātra praśasyate/
346.024. sānukrośaḥ kṣamāyuktaḥ strīkāmo bhakṣalolupaḥ/
346.025. āyuṣmān paśumān dhanyo mahābhogo 'tra jāyate//134// rohiṇyām//
body.translated_text: 'Rainfall by the rain-god and birth are praised under this. One born under <s>Rohiṇī</s> is compassionate, endowed with patience, fond of women, gluttonous, long-lived, rich in cattle, wealthy, and blessed with great enjoyment.' //134// For <s>Rohiṇī</s>.

body.text:
346.026. saumyaṃ mṛgaśiro vidyād ṛju tisraśca tārakāḥ/
346.027. mṛdūni yāni karmāṇi tāni sarvāṇi kārayet/
346.028. yāni karmāṇi rohiṇyāṃ tāni sarvāṇi kārayet//135//
body.translated_text: 'Know that the gentle <s>Mṛgaśiras</s> has three straight stars. All gentle activities should be undertaken. All the activities prescribed for <s>Rohiṇī</s> should also be undertaken.' //135//

body.text:
346.029. sakṣīrān vāpayed vṛkṣān bījāni kṣīravanti ca/
346.030. rājaprāsādavalabhīchatrāṇyapi ca kārayet//136//
body.translated_text:
346.029. 'One should plant trees that bear milk-sap, and milk-bearing seeds;
346.030. and have royal palace parapets and parasols constructed.' //136//

body.text:
346.031. sarvakarmakathāḥ kuryāt caryāvāsānna kārayet/
346.032. aṣṭrāṃśca balīvardāṃśca damayedapi kṛṣṭaye//137//
body.translated_text:
346.031. 'One should perform all kinds of work, but should not build lodging-houses.
346.032. One should tame draft-oxen and bulls for plowing.' //137//

body.text:
347.001. <347>ācchādayennavaṃ vāsaścālaṃkāraṃ ca kārayet/
347.002. dvijātīnāṃ tu karmāṇi sarvāṇyevātra kārayet//138//
body.translated_text:
347.001. 'One should put on new garments and have ornaments made.
347.002. All the rites of the twice-born should be performed here.' //138//

body.text:
347.003. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭiṃ cātra nirdiśet/
347.004. svapnaśīlastathā trāsī medhāvī sa ca jāyate//139// mṛgaśirasi//
body.translated_text:
347.003. 'The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as abundant rain.
347.004. One born here is sleepy, timid, and yet intelligent.' //139// Under <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>.

body.text:
347.005. ārdrāyāṃ mṛgayedarthān bhadraṃ karma ca kārayet/
347.006. krūrakarmāṇi sidhyanti tāni vidvān vivarjayet//140//
body.translated_text:
347.005. 'Under <s>Ārdr��</s>, one should seek wealth and perform auspicious rites.
347.006. Cruel deeds succeed here — the wise should avoid them.' //140//

body.text:
347.007. udapānaparīkhāṃśca taḍāgānyatra kārayet/
347.008. ūheta (uhayet) prathamāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ vikrīṇīyācca nātra gām/
347.009. tilapīḍāni karmāṇi śauṇḍikānāṃ tathāpaṇam//141//
body.translated_text:
347.007. 'One should have wells, moats, and reservoirs constructed here.
347.008. One should predict the first rain; cattle should not be sold here.
347.009. Oil-pressing operations and the shops of liquor-sellers should be established.' //141//

body.text:
347.010. pīḍayedikṣudaṇḍāni ikṣubījāni vāpayet/
347.011. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya vidyādbahuparisravam/
347.012. krodhano mṛgayāśīlo māṃsakāmo 'tra jāyate//142// ārdrāyām//
body.translated_text:
347.010. 'One should press sugarcane stalks and plant sugarcane seeds.
347.011. The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as heavy and copious.
347.012. One born here is wrathful, fond of hunting, and desirous of meat.' //142// Under <s>Ārdrā</s>.

body.text:
347.013. punarvasau tu yukte 'tra kuryādvai vratadhāraṇam/
347.014. godānaṃ copanāyanaṃ sarvamatra prasidhyati//143//
body.translated_text:
347.013. 'Under <s>Punarvasu</s>, one should undertake the observance of vows.
347.014. The gift of a cow and the investiture ceremony — all succeed here.' //143//

body.text:
347.015. prajāyamānāṃ pramadāṃ gṛhītvā gṛhamānayet/
347.016. punaḥ punaryadīccheta tatra karmāṇi kārayet//144//
body.translated_text:
347.015. 'A woman about to give birth should be taken and brought home.
347.016. If one wishes to repeat something, the rites should be performed here.' //144//

body.text:
347.017. cikitsanaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchenna parābhavam/
347.018. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya janma cātra praśasyate//145//
body.translated_text:
347.017. 'Medical treatment should not be undertaken, if one desires not to fail.
347.018. The rain-god's rainfall and birth here are praised.' //145//

body.text:
347.019. alolaścātra jāyeta strīlolaścāpi mānavaḥ/
347.020. citraśīlaśca naikatrārpitacittaḥ sa ucyate//146// punarvasau//
body.translated_text:
347.019. 'One born here is steady and yet also fond of women;
347.020. of diverse character, with mind not fixed on one thing — so it is said.' //146// Under <s>Punarvasu</s>.

body.text:
347.021. dhanyam yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṣye nityaṃ prayojayet/
347.022. sarveṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet//147//
body.translated_text:
347.021. 'Under <s>Pu��ya</s>, one should always employ what is auspicious, glorious, and life-extending.
347.022. All the rites of all the twice-born should be performed here.' //147//

body.text:
347.023. rājāmātyaṃ prayuñjīta śuśrūṣāṃ vinayaṃ caret/
347.024. rājānamabhiṣiñcecca alaṃkuryātsvakāṃ tanum//148//
body.translated_text:
347.023. 'One should appoint a royal minister and practice obedience and discipline.
347.024. One should consecrate a king and adorn one's own body.' //148//

body.text:
347.025. śmaśrukarmāṇi kuryācca vapanaṃ nakhalomataḥ/
347.026. purohitaṃ ca kurvīta dhvajāgraṃ ca prakārayet//149//
body.translated_text:
347.025. 'One should have shaving done — cutting of hair and nails.
347.026. One should appoint a chief priest and raise a banner-top.' //149//

body.text:
347.027. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya mandavarṣaṃ samādiśet/
347.028. na ca rogo na cauraśca kṣemaṃ cātra sadā bhavet//150//
body.translated_text:
347.027. 'The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as light rain.
347.028. There is no disease, no thief, and security always prevails here.' //150//

body.text:
347.029. puṣyeṇa nityayuktaḥ san sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet/
347.030. vaireṇātropanāhaiśca ye janāstān vivarjayet/
347.031. āyuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca mahābhogaḥ prajāyate//151// puṣye//
body.translated_text:
347.029. 'One who is constantly engaged under <s>Puṣya</s> accomplishes all deeds.
347.030. One should avoid people here who are hostile and resentful.
347.031. One born here is long-lived, famous, and of great wealth.' //151// Under <s>Puṣya</s>.

body.text:
348.001. <348>sidhyate dāruṇaṃ karma āśleṣāyāṃ ca kārayet/
348.002. duryādābharaṇānyatra prākāramupakalpayet//152//
body.translated_text:
348.001. 'Harsh deeds succeed under <s>Āśleṣā</s> — they should be performed here.
348.002. One should have ornaments made and a rampart constructed.' //152//

body.text:
348.003. dehabandhaṃ nadībandhaṃ saṃdhikarma ca kārayet/
348.004. prabhūtadaṃśamaśakaṃ varṣaṃ mandaṃ ca varṣati/
348.005. krodhanaḥ svapnaśīlaśca kuhakaścātra jāyate//153// āśleṣāyām//
body.translated_text:
348.003. 'One should have body-binding, river-damming, and joining work done.
348.004. There are abundant biting insects and mosquitoes; the rain falls gently.
348.005. One born here is wrathful, sleepy, and deceitful.' //153// Under <s>Āśleṣā</s>.

body.text:
348.006. maghāsu sarvadhānyāni vāpayetsaṃharedapi/
348.007. saṃghātakarma kurvīta sumukhaṃ cātra kārayet//154//
body.translated_text:
348.006. 'Under the <s>Maghās</s>, one should sow and also harvest all grains.
348.007. One should perform collective work and have auspicious rites done.' //154//

body.text:
348.008. koṣṭhāgārāṇi kurvīta phalaṃ cātra niveśayet/
348.009. sarvadā pitṛdevebhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ caivātra kārayet//155//
body.translated_text:
348.008. 'One should have granaries built and store fruits here.
348.009. One should always perform <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) for the ancestral deities here.' //155//

body.text:
348.010. sasyānāṃ bahulībhāvo yadi devo 'tra varṣati/
348.011. suhṛcca dvārikaścaiva rasakāmaśca jāyate/
348.012. āyuṣmān bahuputraśca strīkāmo bhaktalolupaḥ//156//
body.translated_text:
348.010. 'If the rain-god rains here, there is an abundance of crops.
348.011. One born here is friendly, a doorkeeper, and desirous of flavors,
348.012. long-lived, with many sons, fond of women, and greedy for food.' //156//

body.text:
348.013. saṃgrāmaṃ jīyate tatra yadi pūrvaṃ pravartate/
348.014. dāruṇāni ca karmāṇi tāni vidvān vivarjayet//157// maghāsu//
body.translated_text:
348.013. 'A battle is lost there if one attacks first.
348.014. Harsh deeds succeed here — the wise should avoid them.' //157// Under the <s>Maghās</s>.

body.text:
348.015. phalgunīṣu ca pūrvāsu saubhāgyārthāni kārayet/
348.016. viśeṣādāmalakyādiphalānāmupakārayet//158//
body.translated_text:
348.015. 'Under the <s>Pūrvaphalgunīs</s>, one should perform rites for good fortune;
348.016. especially the preparation of <s>āmalakī</s> (myrobalan) and other fruits.' //158//

body.text:
348.017. kumārīmaṅgalārthāni snāpanāni ca kārayet/
348.018. kanyāpravahanārthāya vihāraṃ caiva kārayet//159//
body.translated_text:
348.017. 'One should have auspicious rites for maidens and bathing ceremonies performed,
348.018. and have a pleasure-garden built for the purpose of giving away a maiden.' //159//

body.text:
348.019. veśmāni kārayettatra vaiśyamatra prayojayet/
348.020. bhāgam ye copajīvanti teṣāṃ karma prayojayet//160//
body.translated_text:
348.019. 'One should have houses built here and employ a <s>vaiśya</s>.
348.020. For those who live by shares, their work should be employed here.' //160//

body.text:
348.021. avyaktakeśo 'keśaḥ subhagaścātra jāyate/
348.022. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet/
348.023. naṣṭaṃ viddhaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpi na tadastīti nirdiśet//161// pūrvaphalgunyām//
body.translated_text:
348.021. 'One born here has sparse hair or is bald, yet is fortunate.
348.022. The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as abundant rain.
348.023. What is lost, damaged, or done — one should declare "it does not exist."' //161// Under <s>Pūrvaphalgunī</s>.

body.text:
348.024. uttarāyāṃ tu phalgunyāṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet/
348.025. medhāvī darśanīyaśca yaśasvī cātra jāyate//162//
body.translated_text:
348.024. 'Under <s>Uttaraphalgunī</s>, all rites should be performed.
348.025. One born here is intelligent, handsome, and famous.' //162//

body.text:
348.026. athātra naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā sarvamastīti nirdiśet/
348.027. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya vidyātsampadanuttamām//163// uttaraphalgunyām//
body.translated_text:
348.026. 'What is lost or burned here — one should declare "it all still exists."
348.027. The rain-god's rainfall should be known as unsurpassed prosperity.' //163// Under <s>Uttaraphalgunī</s>.

body.text:
348.028. hastena laghukarmāṇi sarvāṇyeva prayojayet/
348.029. sarveṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet//164//
body.translated_text:
348.028. 'Under <s>Hasta</s>, all light tasks should be employed.
348.029. All the rites of all the twice-born should be performed here.' //164//

body.text:
348.030. hastyārohaṃ mahāmātraṃ puṣkariṇīṃ ca kārayet/
348.031. cauryaṃ ca sidhyate tatra tacca vidvān vivarjayet//165//
body.translated_text:
348.030. 'One should have elephant-mounting, a great minister, and a lotus-pond made here.
348.031. Theft succeeds here — the wise should avoid it.' //165//

body.text:
349.001. <349>pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya varṣā viśrāvaṇī bhavet/
349.002. athātra jātaṃ jānīyācchūraṃ cauraṃ vicakṣaṇam/
349.003. kuśalaṃ sarvavidyāsu arogaṃ cirajīvinam//166// haste//
body.translated_text:
349.001. 'The rain-god's rainfall should be known as a rain with thunder.
349.002. One born here should be known as brave, a thief, discerning,
349.003. skilled in all sciences, healthy, and long-lived.' //166// Under <s>Hasta</s>.

body.text:
349.004. citrāyāmahataṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca kārayet/
349.005. rājānaṃ bhūṣitaṃ paśyet senāvyūhaṃ ca darśayet//167//
body.translated_text:
349.004. 'Under <s>Citrā</s>, one should have unworn cloth and ornaments made.
349.005. One should behold an adorned king and display an army formation.' //167//

body.text:
349.006. hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ dravyaṃ nagarāṇi ca māpayet/
349.007. alaṃkuryāttathātmānaṃ gandhamālyavilepanaiḥ//168//
body.translated_text:
349.006. 'One should measure out gold, silver, goods, and cities.
349.007. One should adorn oneself with perfumes, garlands, and unguents.' //168//

body.text:
349.008. gaṇakānāṃ ca vidyāṃ ca vādyaṃ nartanagāyanam/
349.009. pūrvikāṃ rūpakārāṃśca rathakārāṃśca śikṣayet/
349.010. citrakārāṃśca lekhakān pustakarma ca kārayet//169//

349.011. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya citravarṣaṃ vinirdiśet/
349.012. medhāvī darśanīyaśca citrākṣo bhaktalolupaḥ//170//
body.translated_text:
349.011. 'The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as variegated rain.
349.012. One born here is intelligent, handsome, with variegated eyes, and greedy for food.' //170//

body.text:
349.013. mṛduśīlaśca bhīruśca calacittaḥ kutūhalī/
349.014. āyuṣmān subhagaścaiva strīlolaścātra jāyate//171// citrāyām//
body.translated_text:
349.013. 'Of gentle character, timid, fickle-minded, and curious,
349.014. long-lived, fortunate, and fond of women — one is born here.' //171// Under <s>Citrā</s>.

body.text:
349.015. svātyāṃ prayojayedyodhān aśvānaśvatarīṃ kharān/
349.016. kṣipraṃ gamanīyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ laṅghakānadhvamānikān//172//
body.translated_text:
349.015. 'Under <s>Svātī</s>, one should employ warriors, horses, mules, and donkeys,
349.016. swift-going provisions, and acrobats and road-measurers.' //172//

body.text:
349.017. bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavān murajāṃścopanāhayet/
349.018. āvāṃhāśca vivāhāṃśca sauhṛdyaṃ cātra kārayet//173//
body.translated_text:
349.017. 'One should bind kettledrums, <s>mṛdaṅgas</s>, <s>paṇavas</s>, and barrel-drums.
349.018. Bride-fetching, marriages, and friendship-pacts should be made here.' //173//

body.text:
349.019. nirvāsanamamitrāṇāṃ svayaṃ na pravasedgṛhāt/
349.020. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya vātavṛṣṭirabhīkṣṇaśaḥ/
349.021. medhāvī rogabahulaścalacittaśca jāyate//174// svātau//
body.translated_text:
349.019. 'The banishment of enemies is appropriate, but one should not leave home oneself.
349.020. The rain-god's rainfall is frequent wind-driven rain.
349.021. One born here is intelligent, much-afflicted by illness, and fickle-minded.' //174// Under <s>Svātī</s>.

body.text:
349.022. lāṅgalāni viśākhāsu karṣaṇaṃ ca prayojayet/
349.023. yavagodhūmakarmāntāñ śamīdhānyaṃ ca varjayet//175//
body.translated_text:
349.022. 'Under the <s>Viśākhās</s>, plows and plowing should be employed.
349.023. Barley and wheat operations should be pursued, but <s>śamī</s>-grain should be avoided.' //175//

body.text:
349.024. śālayastilamāṣāśca ye ca vṛkṣāḥ suśākhinaḥ/
349.025. ropayettān viśākhāsu gṛhakarma ca kārayet/
349.026. śiraḥsnānāni kurvīta medhyaṃ prāyaśca kārayet//176//
body.translated_text:
349.024. 'Rice, sesame, and <s>māṣa</s> beans, and trees with good branches —
349.025. these should be planted under the <s>Viśākhās</s>, and house-building should be done.
349.026. Head-baths should be performed, and purificatory and expiatory rites.' //176//

body.text:
349.027. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya vidyātkalpaparisravam/
349.028. manasvī darśanīyaśca medhāvī cātra jāyate/
349.029. krodhano 'lpasutaścaiva durbhago bhaktalolupaḥ//177// viśākhāsu//
body.translated_text:
349.027. 'The rain-god's rainfall should be known as moderate and copious.
349.028. One born here is spirited, handsome, and intelligent,
349.029. but wrathful, with few sons, unfortunate, and greedy for food.' //177// Under the <s>Viśākhās</s>.

body.text:
349.030. anurādhāsu kurvīta mitraiḥ sadbhiśca saṃgatim/
349.031. sarvāṇi mṛdukarmāṇi mādhuryaṃ cātra kārayet//178//
body.translated_text:
349.030. 'Under <s>Anurādhā</s>, one should seek the company of good friends.
349.031. All gentle tasks and what is sweet should be done here.' //178//

body.text:
350.001. <350>kṣauraṃ ca kārayedatra śastrakarmāṇi kārayet/
350.002. samyuktāntaprayogāṃśca saṃdhiṃ kuryācca nityaśaḥ/
350.003. naṣṭaṃ paryupataptaṃ vā svalpāyāsena nirdiśet//179//
body.translated_text:
350.001. 'Shaving should be done here, and tasks involving implements.
350.002. Operations involving the combination of endings and joints should be made constantly.
350.003. What is lost or ruined — it should be declared recoverable with little effort.' //179//

body.text:
350.004. suhṛnmitrakṛtaścātra dharmaśīlaśca jāyate/
350.005. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//180// anurādhāyām//
body.translated_text:
350.004. 'One born here is friendly, devoted to companions, and of righteous character.
350.005. The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as abundant rain.' //180// Under <s>Anurādhā</s>.

body.text:
350.006. jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvakārī syādrājānaṃ cābhiṣiñcayet/
350.007. nagaraṃ nigamaṃ grāmaṃ māpayedārabheta ca/
350.008. kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca rājñāṃ ca sarvakarmāṇi kārayet//181//
body.translated_text:
350.006. 'Under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, one should take initiative and consecrate a king.
350.007. One should measure and found a city, a market-town, or a village.
350.008. All rites of <s>kṣatriyas</s> and kings should be performed here.' //181//

body.text:
350.009. bhrātṛrṇāṃ bhavati jyeṣṭho jyeṣṭhāyām yo 'bhijāyate/
350.010. āyuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca vidvatsu ca kutūhalī//182//
body.translated_text:
350.009. 'Among brothers, the one born under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> becomes the eldest.
350.010. He is long-lived, famous, and curious about the learned.' //182//

body.text:
350.011. prāsādamāroheccātra gajamaśvaṃ rathaṃ tathā/
350.012. grāmanigamarāṣṭreṣu sthāpayecchreṣṭhinā balam//183//
body.translated_text:
350.011. 'One should ascend a palace, an elephant, a horse, or a chariot here.
350.012. In villages, market-towns, and kingdoms, one should station a chief with an army.' //183//

body.text:
350.013. naṣṭaṃ paryupataptaṃ vā kleśenaiveti nirdiśet/
350.014. dāruṇānyatra sidhyanti tāni vidvān vivarjayet/
350.015. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//184// jyeṣṭhāyām//
body.translated_text:
350.013. 'What is lost or ruined — it should be declared recoverable only with difficulty.
350.014. Harsh deeds succeed here — the wise should avoid them.
350.015. The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as abundant rain.' //184// Under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>.

body.text:
350.016. mūle tu mūlajātāni mūlakandālukānyapi/
350.017. mūlādyāni ca sarvāṇi bījānyatra prayojayet//185//
body.translated_text:
350.016. 'Under <s>Mūla</s>, roots, root-born plants, tubers, and root-bulbs,
350.017. and all root-primary seeds should be employed here.' //185//

body.text:
350.018. ṛṇaṃ vai yatpurāṇaṃ syādartho vāsyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ/
350.019. mūle siddhyarthamārabhyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ barāṅgakam//186//
body.translated_text:
350.018. 'Whatever old debt there may be, or wealth that stands before one —
350.019. under <s>Mūla</s>, one should undertake what brings success, and all physical tasks.' //186//

body.text:
350.020. cikitsitāni yānīha strīṇāṃ dārakakanyayoḥ/
350.021. nadīṣu snapanaṃ caiva mūle sarvān prayojayet//187//
body.translated_text:
350.020. 'Medical treatments — those for women, boys, and girls,
350.021. and bathing in rivers — all should be employed under <s>Mūla</s>.' //187//

body.text:
350.022. dāruṇānyatra sidhyanti maṅgalāni ca kārayet/
350.023. kiṇvayogān surāyogānna kuryācchatrubhiḥ saha//188//
body.translated_text:
350.022. 'Harsh deeds succeed here, and auspicious rites should be performed.
350.023. Fermentation preparations and liquor preparations should not be made with enemies.' //188//

body.text:
350.024. dhanavān bahuputraśca mūlavānatra jāyate/
350.025. athātra naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā naitadastīti nirdiśet/
350.026. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//189// mūle//
body.translated_text:
350.024. 'One born here is wealthy, with many sons, and firmly rooted.
350.025. What is lost or burned here — one should declare "it does not exist."
350.026. The rain-god's rainfall should be predicted as abundant rain.' //189// Under <s>Mūla</s>.

body.text:
350.027. āṣāḍhāyāṃ ca pūrvasyāṃ saritaśca sarāṃsi ca/
350.028. vāpīkūpaprapāścaiva taḍāgāni ca kārayet//190//
body.translated_text:
350.027. 'Under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, rivers and lakes,
350.028. wells, step-wells, water-stations, and reservoirs should be constructed.' //190//

body.text:
350.029. utpādyāni ca puṣpāṇi tathā mūlaphalāni ca/
350.030. ārāmāṃśca prakurvīta bhaikṣakāṃśca prayojayet/
350.031. yāni cogrāṇi karmāṇi sidhyantyatra tu tāni ca//191//

351.001. <351>naṣṭaṃ paryupatāptaṃ vā naitadastīti nirdiśet/
351.002. āyuṣmān puṇyaśīlaśca darśanīyo 'tra jāyate//192// pūrvāṣāḍhāyām//
body.translated_text:
351.001. 'What is lost or ruined — one should declare "it does not exist."
351.002. One born here is long-lived, of meritorious character, and handsome.' //192// Under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>.

body.text:
351.003. uttarasyāmāṣāḍhāyāṃ vairāṇi na samācaret/
351.004. vāyayetsarvavāsāṃsi navaṃ nācchādayediti//193//
body.translated_text:
351.003. 'Under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, one should not engage in hostilities.
351.004. One should air out all garments but should not put on new ones.' //193//

body.text:
351.005. na saṃharedbhedayedvā vāstukarma na sidhyati/
351.006. śālākarma gavādīnāṃ grāme grāmaṇinastathā/
351.007. śreṇībandhaṃ ca rājā tu samayaṃ cātra kārayet//194//
body.translated_text:
351.005. 'One should not gather or divide; house-building does not succeed.
351.006. Construction of cattle-sheds and the like, and village headmen,
351.007. the binding of guilds — the king should establish agreements here.' //194//

body.text:
351.008. pragalbhaśca sabhāśīlaḥ kṛtī cātra prajāyate/
351.009. suhṛdāmabhiyogī ca mantrabhāṣye vicakṣaṇaḥ//195//
body.translated_text:
351.008. 'One born here is bold, fond of assemblies, and accomplished;
351.009. a seeker of companions and skilled in counsel and speech.' //195//

body.text:
351.010. naṣṭaṃ vāpyupataptaṃ vā astītyevaṃ vinirdiśet/
351.011. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//196// uttarāṣāḍhāyām//
body.translated_text:
351.010. 'Whether lost or afflicted, one should declare: "It exists."
351.011. And one should declare good rainfall for the rain of the gods.' //196// Under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>.

body.text: 351.012. abhijiti na kurvīta brahmadevasya hyarcanam//197// abhijiti//
body.translated_text: 351.012. 'Under <s>Abhijit</s>, one should not perform the worship of <s>Brahmadeva</s>.' //197// Under <s>Abhijit</s>.

body.text:
351.013. śravaṇe na ca kurvīta sarvāḥ saṃgrāmikāḥ kriyāḥ/
351.014. gītaśikṣādhyayanaṃ ca na cireṇa hi sidhyati//198//
body.translated_text:
351.013. 'Under <s>Śravaṇa</s>, one should not undertake any military operations.
351.014. The study of singing and recitation does not succeed quickly.' //198//

body.text:
351.015. karṇayorvedhanaṃ kuryādrājānaṃ cābhiṣiñcayet/
351.016. dvijātīnāṃ tu karmāṇi sarvāṇyeva prayojayet//199//
body.translated_text:
351.015. 'One should pierce the ears, and one should consecrate a king.
351.016. All rites for the twice-born should be performed.' //199//

body.text:
351.017. balikṛtyāni kurvīta darśayecca balānyapi/
351.018. medhāvyarogī balavān yajñaśīlo 'tra jāyate//200//
body.translated_text:
351.017. 'One should perform offering-rites and also display armies.
351.018. One born here is intelligent, healthy, strong, and devoted to sacrifice.' //200//

body.text:
351.019. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet/
351.020. naṣṭaṃ ca labhyate tatra śravaṇasthe niśākare//201// śravaṇe//
body.translated_text:
351.019. 'And one should declare good rainfall for the rain of the gods.
351.020. What is lost is found there, when the moon is stationed in <s>Śravaṇa</s>.' //201// Under <s>Śravaṇa</s>.

body.text:
351.021. dhaniṣṭhā laghunakṣatraṃ sarvakarmasu pūjitam/
351.022. adhītya brāhmaṇaḥ snāyādrājānmabhiṣiñcayet//202//
body.translated_text:
351.021. '<s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s> is a swift <s>nakṣatra</s>, honored in all undertakings.
351.022. A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, having completed his studies, should bathe, and should consecrate a king.' //202//

body.text:
351.023. sarveṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet/
351.024. śreṣṭhinaṃ sthāpayed deśe gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gaṇeṣvapi//203//
body.translated_text:
351.023. 'One should have all rites performed for all the twice-born.
351.024. One should appoint a guild-master in the region and a chief of guilds among the guilds.' //203//

body.text:
351.025. medhāvī ca yaśasvī ca mahābhogī mahādhanaḥ/
351.026. bahvapatyo mṛdurdānto mahātmā cātra jāyate//204//
body.translated_text:
351.025. 'One born here is intelligent, renowned, of great wealth and great riches,
351.026. of many offspring, gentle, self-controlled, and great-souled.' //204//

body.text:
351.027. naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ praviddhaṃ vā kleśenaivātra labhyate/
351.028. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya vidyāccātra suvṛṣṭitām//205// dhaniṣṭhāyām//
body.translated_text:
351.027. 'What is lost, burned, or thrown away is recovered here only with difficulty.
351.028. And one should know good rainfall for the rain of the gods here.' //205// Under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>.

body.text:
351.029. nityaṃ śatabhiṣāyoge bhaiṣajyāni prayojayet/
351.030. kīrtikarma ca kurvīta sidhyantyātharvaṇāni ca//206//
body.translated_text:
351.029. 'When the conjunction is with <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, one should always apply medicines.
351.030. One should perform rites for fame, and the <s>Ātharvaṇa</s> (Atharvan) rites succeed.' //206//

body.text:
352.001. <352>prasārayecca paṇyāni śauṇḍikaṃ ca prayojayet/
352.002. udadhiṃ khānayettatra tilamāṣāṃśca vāpayet//207//
body.translated_text:
352.001. 'One should spread merchandise and employ a tavern-keeper.
352.002. One should dig a reservoir there and sow sesame and beans.' //207//

body.text:
352.003. sāmudrikāṇi paṇyāni nāvinaśca prayojayet/
352.004. ādeyaṃ ca tadādadyād vyayaṃ cātra na kārayet//208//
body.translated_text:
352.003. 'One should employ overseas merchandise and ship-owners.
352.004. One should collect revenues and not incur expenses here.' //208//

body.text:
352.005. sāṃdhipālān dvārapālāmllekhakāṃśca prayojayet/
352.006. bhiṣakkarma ca kurvīt bhaiṣajyāni ca saṃharet//209//
body.translated_text:
352.005. 'One should employ border-guards, gate-keepers, and scribes.
352.006. One should perform medical work and gather medicines.' //209//

body.text:
352.007. nidhiṃ vā khānayettatra nidadhyādapi vā nidhim/
352.008. dhanaṃ cātra prayuñjīt bhiṣakkarma ca śikṣayet//210//
body.translated_text:
352.007. 'One should dig for treasure there, or deposit treasure.
352.008. One should invest wealth here and study the medical art.' //210//

body.text:
352.009. athātra mṛgayennaṣṭaṃ labhyate taccirādapi/
352.010. arogī krodhanaścātra svapnaśīlaśca jāyate/
352.011. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//211// śatabhiṣāyām//
body.translated_text:
352.009. 'If one searches for what is lost here, it is found even after a long time.
352.010. One born here is healthy, wrathful, and given to sleep.
352.011. And one should declare good rainfall for the rain of the gods.' //211// Under <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>.

body.text:
352.012. pūrvabhādrapadāyoge krūrāṇāṃ siddhirucyate/
352.013. naṣṭaviddhopataptaṃ vā naitadastīti nirdiśet//212//
body.translated_text:
352.012. 'Under the conjunction of <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>, success in cruel undertakings is declared.
352.013. Whether lost, struck, or afflicted — one should declare: "It does not exist."' //212//

body.text:
352.014. dīrghaśrotro mahābhogo jñātīnāṃ ca sadā priyaḥ/
352.015. mahādhano 'krūrakarmā niḥkrodhaścātra jāyate/
352.016. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya caṇḍāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ samādiśet//213// pūrvabhādrapade//
body.translated_text:
352.014. 'One born here has long ears, great possessions, is always dear to kinsmen,
352.015. of great wealth, not cruel in deeds, and free from anger.
352.016. And one should declare violent rainfall for the rain of the gods.' //213// Under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>.

body.text:
352.017. uttarasyāṃ tu kurvīt āyuṣyaṃ puṣṭikarma ca/
352.018. na ca dakṣiṇato gacchetpuraṃ cātra pradāpayet//214//
body.translated_text:
352.017. 'Under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>, one should perform rites for longevity and nourishment.
352.018. One should not travel southward, and one should make a gift of a city here.' //214//

body.text:
352.019. āyuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca dhanavāṃścātra jāyate/
352.020. atrāpi triguṇaṃ vindedādānam yadi vā vyayam/
352.021. pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭimabhinirdiśet//215// uttarabhādrapade//
body.translated_text:
352.019. 'One born here is long-lived, renowned, and wealthy.
352.020. Here too one obtains threefold — whether income or expenditure.
352.021. And one should declare good rainfall for the rain of the gods.' //215// Under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>.

body.text:
352.022. revatyāṃ ratnarajataṃ dhanadhānyaṃ prayojayet/
352.023. koṣṭhāgārāṇi kurvīt kiṇvaṃ cātra na kārayet//216//
body.translated_text:
352.022. 'Under <s>Revatī</s>, one should employ gems, silver, wealth, and grain.
352.023. One should build granaries, and one should not make fermented preparations here.' //216//

body.text:
352.024. surākarma ca kurvīd dhiraṇyaṃ govrajāni ca/
352.025. gosaṃghaṃ sthāpayeccātra gośālāṃ cātra kārayet/
352.026. ācchādayennavaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyamapi dhārayet//217//
body.translated_text:
352.024. 'One should make liquor, and also employ gold and cattle-pens.
352.025. One should establish a herd of cattle here and build a cow-shed here.
352.026. One should put on new garments and also wear gold.' //217//

body.text:
352.027. bhikṣuko dānaśīlaśca daridraścānasūyakaḥ/
352.028. jñātīnāṃ sevako nityaṃ dharmajñaścātra jāyate/
352.029. suvṛṣṭiṃ naṣṭalābhaṃ ca revatyāmabhinirdiśet//218// revatyām//
body.translated_text:
352.027. 'One born here is a beggar, generous, poor, and free from envy,
352.028. always devoted to kinsmen, and knowledgeable in <s>Dharma</s>.
352.029. Under <s>Revatī</s>, one should declare good rainfall and recovery of what is lost.' //218// Under <s>Revatī</s>.

body.text:
352.030. strīpuṃsamaśvinā yuñjādaśvaśālāṃ ca kārayet/
352.031. aśvān prayojayedatra rathaṃ cātra prayojayet//219//
body.translated_text:
352.030. 'Under <s>Aśvinī</s>, one should yoke male and female horses and build a horse-stable.
352.031. One should employ horses here and also employ a chariot here.' //219//

body.text:
353.001. <353>ṛṇaprayogaḥ kartavyo bījānyatra pravāpayet/
353.002. yānāni ca hayān damyān dantinaśca prayojayet//220//
body.translated_text:
353.001. 'Lending on interest should be done; seeds should be sown here.
353.002. One should employ vehicles, horses to be tamed, and elephants.' //220//

body.text:
353.003. bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojayodatra bhiṣakkarma ca kārayet/
353.004. madhāvī darśanīyaśca rājayogyaśca saṃpadā//221//
body.translated_text:
353.003. 'One should feed medicine here and perform medical work.
353.004. One born here is intelligent, handsome, and fit for royal prosperity.' //221//

body.text:
353.005. ārogī balavāṃcchūraḥ subhago hyatra jāyate/
353.006. suvṛṣṭiṃ naṣṭalābhaṃ ca aśvinyāmabhinirdiśet//222// aśvinyām//
body.translated_text:
353.005. 'Healthy, strong, heroic, and fortunate is one born here.
353.006. Under <s>Aśvinī</s>, one should declare good rainfall and recovery of what is lost.' //222// Under <s>Aśvinī</s>.

body.text:
353.007. tritārāṃ bharaṇīṃ vidyātkrūrakarmāṇi sādhayet/
353.008. bhṛtyāṃśca bhṛtakāṃścāpi vṛṇuyāddarśayettathā//223//
body.translated_text:
353.007. 'One should know <s>Bharaṇī</s> as a three-starred one, and accomplish cruel undertakings.
353.008. One should also select and display servants and hired workers.' //223//

body.text:
353.009. bhṛtiṃ copanayedatra bhāryāṃ ca na vivāhayet/
353.010. utkuṭuko vañcanakaḥ kūṭasākṣī ca tandrijaḥ//224//
body.translated_text:
353.009. 'One should pay wages here, but should not marry a wife.
353.010. One born here is a squatter, a cheat, a false witness, and indolent.' //224//

body.text:
353.011. vidhijñaḥ pāpacāritraḥ kadaryaścātra jāyate/
353.012. jāyate cātra duḥśīlo gurūṇāmabhyasūyakaḥ/
353.013. paropatāpī lubdhaśca paravyāhāragocaraḥ//225// bharaṇyām//
body.translated_text:
353.011. 'Knowledgeable in procedure but wicked in conduct, miserly is one born here.
353.012. And one born here is immoral, a reviler of elders,
353.013. a tormentor of others, greedy, and subsisting on others' food.' //225// Under <s>Bharaṇī</s>.

body.text:
353.014. saptavīṃśatinakṣatre kṛttikādi yadā bhavet/
353.015. bharaṇyantāni ṛkṣāṇīmāṃ pratipādayetkriyām//226//
body.translated_text:
353.014. 'When the twenty-seven <s>nakṣatras</s>, beginning with <s>Kṛttikā</s>,
353.015. ending with <s>Bharaṇī</s>, one should apply these prescribed activities.' //226//

body.text:
353.016. teṣāṃ madhye yadā sarve śasyānyoṣadhayo 'pi ca/
353.017. vanaspatayaśca pīḍyante yatrāsau tiṣṭhate grahaḥ/
353.018. sarvaṃ pratipādayitavyamuktanakṣatrakarmasu//227//
body.translated_text:
353.016. 'Among these, when all the crops, herbs,
353.017. and trees are afflicted where that planet is stationed,
353.018. everything should be applied according to the prescribed activities for those <s>nakṣatras</s>.' //227//

body.text: 353.019. ukto nakṣatrakarmanirdeśo nāmādhyāyaḥ//
body.translated_text: 353.019. Thus ends the chapter called 'Instruction on the Activities of the <s>Nakṣatras</s>.'

body.text:
353.020. catvāri bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi dhruvāni bhavanti/
353.020. tāni vyākhyāsyāmi/
353.020. tacchṛṇu/
353.021. tadyathā--trīṇi uttarāṇi rohiṇī ca/
353.021. kṣeme 'dhyāvaset/
353.021. bījāni cātra ropayet/
353.021. niveśanaṃ cātra kalpayet/
353.022. rājānaṃ cābhiṣiñcayet/
353.022. yāni cānyāni uktāni karmāṇi tāni kārayet/
353.023. atha naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā viddhaṃ cāpi hṛtaṃ ca vā/
353.024. evamabhinirdiṣṭaṃ vā svasti kṣipraṃ bhaviṣyati//228//
body.translated_text:
353.020. 'There are, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, four fixed <s>nakṣatras</s>.
353.020. I shall explain them.
353.020. Listen.
353.021. Namely: the three <s>Uttarā</s> <s>nakṣatras</s> and <s>Rohiṇī</s>.
353.021. Under them, one should settle in a safe place.
353.021. Seeds should be sown here.
353.021. A dwelling should be established here.
353.022. A king should be consecrated.
353.022. And whatever other prescribed activities have been mentioned, those should be performed.
353.023. And whether lost, burned, struck, or stolen,
353.024. what is thus declared will quickly become auspicious.' //228//

body.text:
353.025. athātra jāto dhanyo 'sau vidyātmā ca yaśasvī ca/
353.026. maṅgalīyo mahābhogī mahāyogī bhaviṣyati//229//
body.translated_text:
353.025. 'And one born here is fortunate, learned in knowledge, and renowned.
353.026. He will be auspicious, of great wealth, and a great practitioner.' //229//

body.text:
353.027. catvāri bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi kṣiprāṇi bhavanti/
353.027. tadyathā--puṣyo hastābhijidaśvinī ceti/
353.028. eṣu kṣiprāṇi karmāṇi kārayecca vicakṣaṇaḥ/
353.028. svādhyāyaṃ mantrasamārambhaṃ pravāsaprasthānaṃ gāśca turaṅgānapyatra yojayet/
353.029. dhūryāṇi yuktakarmāṇi coṣadhīkarmāṇi ca/
353.030. bhaiṣajyāni sarvāṇyatra prayojayet//
body.translated_text:
353.027. 'There are, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, four swift <s>nakṣatras</s>.
353.027. Namely: <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Abhijit</s>, and <s>Aśvinī</s>.
353.028. Under these, the discerning one should have swift activities performed:
353.028. self-study, the undertaking of mantras, departure for travel, and one should also yoke cows and horses here.
353.029. Draught-work, yoked activities, and herbal activities.
353.030. All medicines should be applied here.'

body.text:
353.031. tatra yajñasamārambhaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ ca kārayet/
353.031. athātra naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā viddhaṃ vā, svasti bhaviṣyatīti vaktavyam//
body.translated_text:
353.031. 'There one should undertake a sacrifice and perform the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (four-monthly rite).
353.031. And if here something is lost, burned, or struck — it should be said: "It will become auspicious."'

body.text:
354.001. <354>athātra jātakaṃ vidyānmaṅgalīyam yaśasvinam/
354.002. mahābhogaṃ ca rājānaṃ mahāyoginamīśvaram//230//
body.translated_text:
354.001. 'And one born here should be known as auspicious, renowned,
354.002. of great wealth, a king, a great practitioner, and a lord.' //230//

body.text:
354.003. mahādhanaṃ mahābhogaṃ tathā ca mahaduttamam/
354.004. kṣatriyaṃ dānaśīlaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ ca purohitam//231// iti//
body.translated_text:
354.003. 'Of great riches, great possessions, and also greatly supreme,
354.004. a <s>Kṣatriya</s> devoted to giving, and a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> as chief priest.' //231//

body.text:
354.005. pañca khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi dāruṇāni bhavanti/
354.005. tadyathā--
354.006. maghā trīṇi ca pūrvāṇi bharaṇī ceti pañcamī/
354.007. athātra dagdhaṃ naṣṭaṃ vā viddhaṃ vā na bhaviṣyati//232//
body.translated_text:
354.005. 'There are, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, five terrible <s>nakṣatras</s>.
354.005. Namely:
354.006. <s>Maghā</s>, the three <s>Pūrvā</s> <s>nakṣatras</s>, and <s>Bharaṇī</s> as the fifth.
354.007. Whether burned, lost, or struck here — it will not be recovered.' //232//

body.text:
354.008. iti vaktavyam/
354.008. ardharātrikāṇi ṣaṭ/
354.008. tadyathā--ārdrā āśleṣā svātī jyeṣṭhā śatabhiṣā bharaṇī ceti/
354.009. navāṃśāḥ ṣaḍgrāsā dvikṣetrāṇi/
354.009. rohiṇī punarvasurviśākhā ca/
354.010. trīṇi uttarāṇi ceti ubhayatovibhāgāni/
354.010. pañcadaśa kṣetrāṇi/
354.010. kṛttikā ca maghā mūlā trīṇi pūrvāṇi/
354.011. imāni ṣaṭ pūrvabhāgikāni/
354.011. mṛgaśirā puṣyā hastā citrā anurādhā śravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā revatī aśvinī ceti imāni nava nakṣatrāṇi pañcādbhāgīyāni triṃśanmuhūrtayogāni kṣetrāṇi ca//
body.translated_text:
354.008. Thus it should be declared.
354.008. Six are the midnight ones.
354.008. Namely: <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Āśleṣā</s>, <s>Svātī</s>, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, and <s>Bharaṇī</s>.
354.009. Nine are the shares, six are the eclipses, and two are the fields:
354.009. <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, and <s>Viśākhā</s>.
354.010. The three <s>Uttarā</s> <s>nakṣatras</s> — these are the ones divided on both sides.
354.010. Fifteen are the fields.
354.010. <s>Kṛttikā</s>, <s>Maghā</s>, <s>Mūlā</s>, and the three <s>Pūrvā</s> <s>nakṣatras</s>.
354.011. These six belong to the first part.
354.011. <s>Mṛgaśirā</s>, <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Citrā</s>, <s>Anurādhā</s>, <s>Śravaṇa</s>, <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, <s>Revatī</s>, and <s>Aśvinī</s> — these nine <s>nakṣatras</s> belong to the latter part, with thirty <s>muhūrta</s> conjunctions and fields.

body.text:
354.014. api ca brāhmaṇa śubhāśca muhūrtā bhavanti, aśubhāśca muhūrtā bhavanti, śubhāśubhāśca muhūrtā bhavanti/
354.015. saṃprayuktanakṣatreṣu sarveṣu yadā śubhamuhūrtasamāpattayo bhavanti, tadā śobhanā bhavanti/
354.016. yadā aśubhamuhūrtasamāpattayo bhavanti, tadā na śobhanā bhavanti/
354.016. yadā tu punaḥ śubhāścāśubhāśca samāpattayo, tadā sādhāraṇā bhavanti//
body.translated_text:
354.014. 'Moreover, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, there are auspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>, inauspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>, and mixed <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.015. When among all the conjoined <s>nakṣatras</s> there are auspicious <s>muhūrta</s> conjunctions, then they are favorable.
354.016. When there are inauspicious <s>muhūrta</s> conjunctions, then they are not favorable.
354.016. But when the conjunctions are both auspicious and inauspicious, then they are ordinary.'

body.text:
354.018. athātra kathaṃ rātridivasānāṃ hrāso vṛddhirvā bhavatīti taducyate/
354.018. varṣāṇāṃ prathame māse puṣyanakṣatramamāvāsyāṃ bhavati, śravaṇā pūrṇamāsyām/
354.019. aṣṭādaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
354.020. dvādaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
354.020. ṣoḍaśāṅgulakāṣṭhasya madhyāhne 'rdhāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
354.021. āṣāḍhā rātriṃ nayati/
354.021. mṛgaśirasi ādityo gato bhavati/
354.021. varṣāṇāṃ dvitīye māse maghā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, bhādrapadā pūrṇamāsyām/
354.022. saptadaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
354.022. trayodaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
354.023. dvyaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
354.023. śravaṇā rātriṃ nayati/
354.023. puṣya ādityo gato bhavati/
354.024. varṣāṇāṃ tṛtīye māse phalgunyamāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, aśvinī pūrṇamāsyām/
354.025. ṣoḍaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
354.025. caturdaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
354.025. cauraṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
354.026. pūrvabhādrapadā rātriṃ nayati/
354.027. maghāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
354.027. varṣāṇāṃ caturthe māse citrā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, kṛttikā pūrṇamāsyām/
354.027. pañcadaśamuhūrto bhavati divasaḥ/
354.027. pañcadaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
354.028. ṣaḍaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
354.028. aśvinī rātriṃ nayati/
354.028. phalgunyāmādityo gato bhavati//
body.translated_text:
354.018. 'Now, how does the decrease and increase of nights and days occur? This is declared:
354.018. In the first month of the rainy season, the <s>Puṣya</s> <s>nakṣatra</s> falls on the new-moon day, and <s>Śravaṇā</s> on the full-moon day.
354.019. The day is eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s> long,
354.020. the night is twelve <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.020. At midday, on a sixteen-<s>aṅgula</s> gnomon, the sun turns at a shadow of half an <s>aṅgula</s>.
354.021. <s>Āṣāḍhā</s> governs the night.
354.021. The sun has gone to <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>.
354.021. In the second month of the rainy season, <s>Maghā</s> falls on the new-moon day, and <s>Bhādrapadā</s> on the full-moon day.
354.022. The day is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s> long,
354.022. the night is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.023. The sun turns at a shadow of two <s>aṅgulas</s>.
354.023. <s>Śravaṇā</s> governs the night.
354.023. The sun has gone to <s>Puṣya</s>.
354.024. In the third month of the rainy season, <s>Phalgunī</s> falls on the new-moon day, and <s>Aśvinī</s> on the full-moon day.
354.025. The day is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s> long,
354.025. the night is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.025. The sun turns at a shadow of four <s>aṅgulas</s>.
354.026. <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s> governs the night.
354.027. The sun has gone to <s>Maghā</s>.
354.027. In the fourth month of the rainy season, <s>Citrā</s> falls on the new-moon day, and <s>Kṛttikā</s> on the full-moon day.
354.027. The day is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>,
354.027. the night is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.028. The sun turns at a shadow of six <s>aṅgulas</s>.
354.028. <s>Aśvinī</s> governs the night.
354.028. The sun has gone to <s>Phalgunī</s>.'

body.text:
354.030. hemantānāṃ prathame māse 'nurādhā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, mṛgaśirā pūrṇamāsyām/
354.030. caturdaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
354.031. ṣoḍaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
354.031. aṣṭāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
body.translated_text:
354.030. 'In the first month of winter, <s>Anurādhā</s> falls on the new-moon day, and <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> on the full-moon day.
354.030. The day is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s> long,
354.031. the night is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
354.031. The sun turns at a shadow of eight <s>aṅgulas</s>.'

body.text:
355.001. <355>kṛttikā rātriṃ nayati/
355.001. citrāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.001. hemantānāṃ dvitīye māse amāvāsyāyāṃ jyeṣṭhā bhavati, puṣyaḥ pūrṇamāsyām/
355.002. trayodaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
355.002. saptadaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.003. daśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.003. mṛgaśirā rātriṃ nayati/
355.003. viśākhāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.004. hemantānāṃ tṛtīye māse pūrvāṣāḍhā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, maghā pūrṇamāsyām/
355.004. dvādaśamuhūrto divase bhavati/
355.005. aṣṭādaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.005. dvādaśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.006. puṣyo rātriṃ nayati/
355.006. jyeṣṭhāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.006. hemantānāṃ caturthe māse śravaṇā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/
355.007. phalgunī pūrṇamāsyām/
355.007. trayodaśamuhūrto divase bhavati/
355.007. saptadaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.008. daśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.008. maghā rātriṃ nayati/
355.008. āṣāḍhāyāmādityo gato bhavati//
body.translated_text:
355.001. <s>Kṛttikā</s> leads the night.
355.001. The sun is situated in <s>Citrā</s>.
355.001. In the second month of winter, on the new-moon day, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> prevails; on the full-moon day, <s>Puṣya</s>.
355.002. The day is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s> long.
355.002. The night is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.003. The sun turns at a shadow of ten finger-breadths.
355.003. <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> leads the night.
355.003. The sun is situated in <s>Viśākhā</s>.
355.004. In the third month of winter, <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s> prevails on the new-moon day, <s>Maghā</s> on the full-moon day.
355.004. The day is twelve <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.005. The night is eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.005. The sun turns at a shadow of twelve finger-breadths.
355.006. <s>Puṣya</s> leads the night.
355.006. The sun is situated in <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>.
355.006. In the fourth month of winter, <s>Śravaṇā</s> prevails on the new-moon day;
355.007. <s>Phalgunī</s> on the full-moon day.
355.007. The day is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.007. The night is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.008. The sun turns at a shadow of ten finger-breadths.
355.008. <s>Maghā</s> leads the night.
355.008. The sun is situated in <s>Āṣāḍhā</s>.

body.text:
355.010. grīṣmāṇāṃ prathame māse uttarabhādrapadā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, citrā pūrṇamāsyām/
355.011. caturdaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
355.011. ṣoḍaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.011. aṣṭāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.012. phalgunī rātriṃ nayati/
355.012. śravaṇāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.012. grīṣmāṇāṃ divitīye māse 'śvinī amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/
355.013. viśākhā pūrṇamāsyām/
355.013. pañcadaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
355.014. pañcadaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.014. ṣaḍaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.014. citrā rātriṃ nayati/
355.015. uttarāyāṃ bhādrapadāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.015. grīṣmāṇāṃ tṛtīye māse kṛttikā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, jyeṣṭhā pūrṇamāsyām/
355.016. ṣoḍaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
355.016. caturdaśamuhūtā rātriḥ/
355.017. caturaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.017. viśākhā rātriṃ nayati/
355.017. kṛttikāyāmādityo gato bhavati/
355.018. grīṣmāṇāṃ caturthe māse mṛgaśirā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati, uttarāṣāḍhā pūrṇamāsyām/
355.018. saptadaśamuhūrto divase bhavati/
355.019. trayodaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
355.019. madhyāhne dvyaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyāmādityaḥ parivartate/
355.020. jyeṣṭhā rātriṃ nayati/
355.020. puṣya ādityo gato bhavati//
body.translated_text:
355.010. In the first month of summer, <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s> prevails on the new-moon day, <s>Citrā</s> on the full-moon day.
355.011. The day is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.011. The night is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.011. The sun turns at a shadow of eight finger-breadths.
355.012. <s>Phalgunī</s> leads the night.
355.012. The sun is situated in <s>Śravaṇā</s>.
355.012. In the second month of summer, <s>Aśvinī</s> prevails on the new-moon day;
355.013. <s>Viśākhā</s> on the full-moon day.
355.013. The day is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.014. The night is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.014. The sun turns at a shadow of six finger-breadths.
355.014. <s>Citrā</s> leads the night.
355.015. The sun is situated in <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>.
355.015. In the third month of summer, <s>Kṛttikā</s> prevails on the new-moon day, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> on the full-moon day.
355.016. The day is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.016. The night is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.017. The sun turns at a shadow of four finger-breadths.
355.017. <s>Viśākhā</s> leads the night.
355.017. The sun is situated in <s>Kṛttikā</s>.
355.018. In the fourth month of summer, <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> prevails on the new-moon day, <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s> on the full-moon day.
355.018. The day is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.019. The night is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
355.019. At midday, the sun turns at a shadow of two finger-breadths.
355.020. <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> leads the night.
355.020. The sun is situated in <s>Puṣya</s>.

body.text:
355.021. saṃvatsaramanveṣaṇato muhūrtaviśeṣaṇaiḥ sarvāṇi caitāni (nakṣatrāṇi) bhāgānubhāgena amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrṇamāsyāṃ ca jujyante/
355.022. ūnarātrasya pūrṇarātrasya ca grahītavyam/
355.022. tatra tṛtīye varṣe 'dhiko māso yujyate/
355.023. ṣaṇṇāṃ māsānāmahorātrāṇi samāni bhavanti/
355.023. ataḥ ṣaṇmāsād divaso vardhate/
355.024. ṣaṇmāsādrātrirvardhate/
355.024. ṣaṇmāsāddivaso māse māse samameva hīyate/
355.024. ṣaṇmāsādrātrirmāse māse parihīyate//
body.translated_text:
355.021. By searching through the year with the distinctions of <s>muhūrtas</s>, all these <s>nakṣatras</s> are conjoined proportionally on the new-moon and full-moon days.
355.022. The deficient night and the complete night must be taken into account.
355.022. There, in the third year, an intercalary month is added.
355.023. For six months, the day-and-nights are equal.
355.023. From then on, for six months the day increases;
355.024. for six months the night increases.
355.024. For six months, the day decreases month by month equally;
355.024. for six months, the night decreases month by month.

body.text:
355.026. ṣaṇmāsādādityaḥ parivartate/
355.026. uttarāṃ diśaṃ saṃcarati/
355.026. ṣaṇmāsāddakṣiṇāṃ diśam/
355.027. ṣaṇmāsātsamudre udakaparimāṇasya hrāso vṛddhiśca bhavati/
355.027. sūryagatyā candragatyā ca samudrodakavelābhivṛddhirbhavati/
355.028. atra gaṇanāpratijāgaraṇāsmaramityevam/
355.028. eṣa saṃvatsaro vyākhyāto bhavati/
355.029. candra ādityaḥ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ śanaiścaro 'ṅgārako budhaśca ime grahāḥ/
355.029. eṣāṃ grahaṇāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ saṃvatsarasthāyī/
355.030. evaṃ śanaiścaro budho 'ṅgārakaḥ śukraśceme maṇḍalacāriṇaḥ//
body.translated_text:
355.026. For six months the sun turns;
355.026. it moves toward the northern direction.
355.026. For six months, toward the southern direction.
355.027. For six months, the measure of water in the ocean decreases and increases.
355.027. By the course of the sun and the course of the moon, the tide of the ocean water increases.
355.028. Here the calculation is to be remembered as a vigilant reckoning.
355.028. Thus the year has been explained.
355.029. The Moon, the Sun, <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter), <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn), <s>Aṅgāraka</s> (Mars), and <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) — these are the planets.
355.029. Among these planets, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> stays for one year in each sign.
355.030. Likewise, <s>Śanaiścara</s>, <s>Budha</s>, <s>Aṅgāraka</s>, and <s>Śukra</s> — these are the circuit-movers.

body.text:
355.031. bharaṇī kṛttikā rohiṇī mṛgaśirā etatsādhāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ maṇḍalam/
355.031. ārdrā punarvasuḥ puṣyo 'śleṣā etatsādhāraṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṇḍalam/
355.032. maghā atha phalgunadvayaṃ hastā citrā etatsādhāraṇam <356>tṛtīyaṃ maṇḍalam/
body.translated_text:
355.031. <s>Bharaṇī</s>, <s>Kṛttikā</s>, <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> — this is the common first division.
355.031. <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Āśleṣā</s> — this is the common second division.
355.032. <s>Maghā</s>, then the two <s>Phalgunīs</s>, <s>Hastā</s>, <s>Citrā</s> — this is the common third division.

body.text:
356.001. svātī viśākhā anurādhā etatsādhāraṇaṃ caturthaṃ maṇḍalam/
356.001. jyeṣṭhā mūlāṣāḍhā dvayamatra sarvāṇi mahābhayāni bhavanti/
356.002. idaṃ pañcamaṃ maṇḍalam/
356.002. abhijicchravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā ubhe bhādrapade caitatsādhāraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalam/
356.003. revatī aśvinī caitatsādhāraṇaṃ saptamaṃ maṇḍalam/
356.004. saṃvatsarameteṣu yadyannakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ pīḍayati, tasya tasya janapadasya sattvasya vā pīḍā nirdeṣṭavyā//
body.translated_text:
356.001. <s>Svātī</s>, <s>Viśākhā</s>, <s>Anurādhā</s> — this is the common fourth division.
356.001. <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Mūlā</s>, and the two <s>Āṣāḍhās</s> — here all great dangers occur.
356.002. This is the fifth division.
356.002. <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Śravaṇā</s>, <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, and the two <s>Bhādrapadās</s> — this is the common sixth division.
356.003. <s>Revatī</s> and <s>Aśvinī</s> — this is the common seventh division.
356.004. If during the year any <s>nakṣatra</s> division is afflicted, the affliction of that particular region or being is to be predicted.

body.text:
356.006. dvādaśa muhūrtāni divase dhruvāṇi, dvādaśa rātrau/
356.006. ṣaṇmuhūrtāḥ saṃcāriṇaḥ/
356.006. katame ṣaṭ? nairṛto varuṇo vāyavo bhargodevo raudro vicārī ca/
356.007. itīme saṃcāriṇaḥ ṣaṭ//
body.translated_text:
356.006. Twelve <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day are fixed, and twelve at night.
356.006. Six <s>muhūrtas</s> are wandering.
356.006. Which six? <s>Nairṛta</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Vāyava</s>, <s>Bhargodeva</s>, <s>Raudra</s>, and <s>Vicārī</s>.
356.007. These are the six wandering ones.

body.text:
356.008. athātra śrāvaṇe māse pūrṇe 'ṣṭādaśamuhūrte divase sūryodaye ca caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.009. rohitasya ca muhūrtasya balasya cāntare madhyāhno bhavati/
356.009. sūryāvatāre tu vicārī nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.010. dvādaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇe sūrye ṣaṣṭhe muhūrte nayamano nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.011. ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto rātryavasāne bhavati/
356.011. bhādrapade māse pūrṇe saptadaśamuhūrte divase sūryodaye ca caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.012. madhyāhne 'bhijito nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.013. sūryāvatāre raudro nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.013. trayodaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇe sūrye vicārī nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.014. ardharātre mahābhayo vāyavo nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
356.008. Now, in the month of <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, when complete, with eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Caturojā</s>.
356.009. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Rohita</s> and <s>Bala</s>, midday occurs.
356.009. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Vicārī</s>.
356.010. In the twelve-<s>muhūrta</s> night, when the sun has set, in the sixth <s>muhūrta</s>, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Nayamāna</s>.
356.011. The <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs at the end of the night.
356.011. In the month of <s>Bhādrapada</s>, when complete, with seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Caturojā</s>.
356.012. At midday, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Abhijit</s>.
356.013. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Raudra</s>.
356.013. In the thirteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, when the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Vicārī</s>.
356.014. At midnight, the <s>muhūrta</s> of great fear is called <s>Vāyava</s>.

body.text:
356.015. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.015. āśvayuje māse pūrṇe ṣoḍaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati/
356.016. sūryodaye caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.016. samudgatasya ca muhūrtasya abhijitasya tvantare madhyāhno bhavati/
356.017. sūryāvatāre bhargodevo nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
356.015. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.
356.015. In the month of <s>Āśvayuja</s>, when complete, the day is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
356.016. At sunrise, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Caturojā</s>.
356.016. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Samudgata</s> and <s>Abhijit</s>, midday occurs.
356.017. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Bhargodeva</s>.

body.text:
356.018. caturdaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇe sūrye raudro nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.018. abhijitasya ca muhūrtasya bhīṣamāṇasya ca muhūrtasya antareṇārdharātraṃ bhavati/
356.019. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
356.018. In the fourteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, when the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Raudra</s>.
356.018. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Abhijit</s> and <s>Bhīṣamāṇa</s>, midnight occurs.
356.019. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.

body.text:
356.021. kārtike māse pūrṇe divasaḥ samarātrirbhavati/
356.021. pañcadaśamuhūrto divaso bhavati, pañcadaśamuhūrtā rātriḥ/
356.022. samāne 'horātre sūryodaye caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.022. saṃmukho nāma muhūrto bhavati madhyāhne/
356.023. saṃtato nāma muhūrtaḥ sūryāvatāre/
356.023. rātrāvavatīrṇamātre sūrye bhargodevo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.024. ārdharātre 'bhijinmuhūrto bhavati/
356.024. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
356.021. In the month of <s>Kārttika</s>, when complete, the day equals the night.
356.021. The day is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, and the night is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>.
356.022. When the day-and-night are equal, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Caturojā</s>.
356.022. At midday, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Saṃmukha</s>.
356.023. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Saṃtata</s>.
356.023. As soon as the sun has set in the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Bhargodeva</s>.
356.024. At midnight, the <s>muhūrta</s> is <s>Abhijit</s>.
356.024. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.

body.text:
356.026. mārgaśīrṣe māse ca pūrṇe caturdaśamuhūrte divase sūryodaye caturojā evaṃ nāṃ muhūrto bhavati/
356.027. viratasya saṃmukhasya ca muhūrtasyāntare madhyāhno bhavati/
356.027. sūryāvatāre varuṇo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.028. ṣoḍaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇamātre sūrye saṃtāpanaḥ samyamo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
356.029. rākṣasasyābhijitasya ca muhūrtasyāntare 'rdharātraṃ bhavati/
356.029. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
356.026. In the month of <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s>, when complete, with fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Caturojā</s>.
356.027. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Virata</s> and <s>Saṃmukha</s>, midday occurs.
356.027. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Varuṇa</s>.
356.028. In the sixteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, as soon as the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Saṃtāpana Samyama</s>.
356.029. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Rākṣasa</s> and <s>Abhijit</s>, midnight occurs.
356.029. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.

body.text:
357.001. <357>pauṣamāse pūrṇe trayodaśamuhūrte divase sūryodaye caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.002. madhyāhne virato nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.002. sūryāvatāre nairṛto nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.002. saptadaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇamātre sūrye varuṇo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.003. ardharātre rākṣaso nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.004. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
357.001. In the month of <s>Pauṣa</s>, when complete, with thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Caturojā</s>.
357.002. At midday, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Virata</s>.
357.002. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Nairṛta</s>.
357.002. In the seventeen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, as soon as the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Varuṇa</s>.
357.003. At midnight, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Rākṣasa</s>.
357.004. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.

body.text:
357.005. māghamāse pūrṇe dvādaśamuhūrte divase sūryodaye caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.005. sāvitrasya ca viratasya ca muhūrtasyāntareṇa madhyāhno bhavati/
357.006. sūryāvatāre vijayo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.007. aṣṭādaśamuhūrtāyāṃ rātrāvavatīrṇamātre sūrye nairṛto nāma muhūrto bhavati/
357.007. gardabhasya muhūrtasya ca rākṣasasya cāntaramardharātraṃ bhavati/
357.008. rātryavasāne ātapāgnirevaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati//
body.translated_text:
357.005. In the month of <s>Māgha</s>, when complete, with twelve <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Caturojā</s>.
357.005. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Sāvitra</s> and <s>Virata</s>, midday occurs.
357.006. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Vijaya</s>.
357.007. In the eighteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, as soon as the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> is called <s>Nairṛta</s>.
357.007. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Gardabha</s> and <s>Rākṣasa</s>, midnight occurs.
357.008. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> is likewise called <s>Ātapāgni</s>.

body.text:
357.008. yathā śrāvaṇe tathā māghe/
357.009. yathā bhādrapade tathā phālgune/
357.009. yathā āśvayuje tathā caitre/
357.010. yathā kārtike tathā vaiśākhe/
357.010. yathā mārgaśīrṣe tathā jyeṣṭhe/
357.010. yathā pauṣe tathā āṣāḍhe/
357.010. evameteṣāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ muhūrtānāṃ caritaṃ vicaritaṃ ca jñātavyam//
body.translated_text:
357.008. As in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, so in <s>Māgha</s>.
357.009. As in <s>Bhādrapada</s>, so in <s>Phālguna</s>.
357.009. As in <s>Āśvayuja</s>, so in <s>Caitra</s>.
357.010. As in <s>Kārttika</s>, so in <s>Vaiśākha</s>.
357.010. As in <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s>, so in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s>.
357.010. As in <s>Pauṣa</s>, so in <s>Āṣāḍha</s>.
357.010. Thus the course and variation of these <s>nakṣatras</s> and <s>muhūrtas</s> is to be understood.

body.text: 357.011. nakṣatravicaraṇaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ//
body.translated_text: 357.011. The first chapter, called 'The Movement of the <s>Nakṣatras</s>.'

body.text:
357.012. yathāmadhyaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ rātrivaśena divasavaśena cotkarṣāpakarṣau kartavyau/
357.012. hīyamāne vardhamāne vā divase vā māse vā pūrṇe 'rdhamāse vā/
357.013. dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī navamī dvādaśī caturdaśī atrāntare divase kalā vardhate, rātrau kalā hīyate//
body.translated_text:
357.012. According to the midpoint of the <s>nakṣatras</s>, by the power of night and by the power of day, the increase and decrease are to be calculated.
357.012. Whether the day or the month is waning or waxing, whether in a complete or half month —
357.013. on the second, sixth, ninth, twelfth, and fourteenth days, during the day the <s>kalā</s> (time-unit) increases; during the night the <s>kalā</s> decreases.

body.text:
357.015. catvāro mahārājāno dhriyate yairvasuṃdharā/
357.016. ativṛddhirviśuddhaśca vardhamānaḥ pṛthakśravāḥ//233//
body.translated_text:
357.015. 'Four Great Kings sustain the earth:
357.016. <s>Ativṛddhi</s> (Great Increase), <s>Viśuddha</s> (Purified), <s>Vardhamāna</s> (Growing), and <s>Pṛthakśravas</s> (Of Separate Fame).' //233//

body.text:
357.017. mahābhūtāni catvāri kampayanti vasuṃdharām/
357.018. āpa indraśca vāyuśca tathāgnirbhagavānapi//234//
body.translated_text:
357.017. 'Four great elements cause the earth to tremble:
357.018. water, <s>Indra</s>, wind, and the blessed fire.' //234//

body.text:
357.019. trayastu te yatra bhavanti pakṣe ṣaḍekamāse tu bhavanti vegāḥ/
357.021. parasya cakrasya nidarśanaṃ syātprakampate yatra mahī tvabhīkṣṇam//235//
body.translated_text:
357.019. 'Three of these occur in a fortnight, and six tremors occur in a single month;
357.021. this would be the evidence of another's wheel — where the great earth trembles frequently.' //235//

body.text:
357.023. viśākhā daśarātrī syājjeṣṭhā dvādaśarātrikā/
357.024. pañcaviṃśatirāṣāḍhā śravaṇā pañcasaptatiḥ//236//
body.translated_text: '<s>Viśākhā</s> has ten nights; <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> has twelve nights; <s>Āṣāḍhā</s> has twenty-five; <s>Śravaṇā</s> has seventy-five.' //236//

body.text:
357.025. rātriśataṃ bhādrapade kraturaśvayuje smṛtaḥ/
357.026. adhyardhaṃ kārtike māse kraturmārgaśire smṛtaḥ//237//
body.translated_text: 'A hundred nights in <s>Bhādrapada</s>; the sacrifice in <s>Āśvayuja</s> is prescribed; one and a half in the month of <s>Kārtika</s>; the sacrifice in <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s> is prescribed.' //237//

body.text:
357.027. pauṣe tu pañcapañcāśanmāghe rātriśataṃ smṛtam/
357.028. adhyardhaṃ phalgune māse caitre triṃśattu rātrayaḥ/
357.029. vipāko bhūmivegānāmataḥ kampaḥ pravartate//238//
body.translated_text: 'Fifty-five in <s>Pauṣa</s>; a hundred nights are prescribed for <s>Māgha</s>; one and a half in the month of <s>Phālguna</s>; thirty nights in <s>Caitra</s>. This is the ripening of the earth's forces — from this, earthquakes proceed.' //238//

body.text:
357.030. yadā sarveṣu māseṣu satataṃ kampate mahī/
357.031. vṛkṣāstathā calanti sma jalam yadi kampate/
357.032. parvataḥ parṇavatkamped bhayamatra vinirdiśet//239//
body.translated_text: 'When in all months the earth quakes continuously, when trees likewise shake, when water trembles, when a mountain quakes like a leaf — danger should be declared.' //239//

body.text:
358.001. <358>nagarāṇyatha vā grāmā ghoṣā ye cātra saṃśritāḥ/
358.002. śīghraṃ bhavanti vijanāraṇyabhūtā mṛgāśrayāḥ//240//
body.translated_text: 'Cities, or villages, or hamlets that are settled there — they quickly become deserted, turned into wilderness, become the refuge of wild animals.' //240//

body.text:
358.003. aṭavyaḥ saṃpravartante daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca/
358.004. anāvāsā diśo vidyād bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//241//
body.translated_text: 'Forests arise for ten and five years; the regions should be known as uninhabitable, shaken by earthquakes.' //241//

body.text:
358.005. kṛttikāsu caled bhūmirgrāmeṣu nagareṣu vā/
358.006. abhīṣkṇaṃ mucyate hyagnirdahate sa tṛṇālayān//242//
body.translated_text: 'If the earth quakes in <s>Kṛttikā</s>, in villages or cities, fire is released repeatedly and burns the grass-dwellings.' //242//

body.text:
358.007. kṛṣṇāgniraśaneḥ pātaḥ karmārā āhitāśrayāḥ/
358.008. agārāśca nivartante saṃvarteneva dhātavaḥ//243//
body.translated_text: 'Dark fires, the fall of lightning, smiths whose dwellings are established — the houses are overturned, the elements as if at the dissolution of the world.' //243//

body.text:
358.009. ye jātā ye ca saṃvṛddhā ye ca taṃ grāmamāśritāḥ/
358.010. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//244//
body.translated_text: 'Those who were born there, those who grew up there, and those who settled in that village — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.' //244//

body.text:
358.011. rohiṇyāṃ calitā bhūmiḥ sarvabījavināśanam/
358.012. proptaṃ śasyaṃ na roheta bhavet phalasya kṛcchratā//245//
body.translated_text: 'When the earth quakes in <s>Rohiṇī</s>, there is destruction of all seeds. Sown crops do not grow; there is difficulty in obtaining fruit.' //245//

body.text:
358.013. gurviṇīnāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ garbho nipīḍyate bhṛśam/
358.014. durbhikṣavyasanākrāntā tribhāge tiṣṭhati prajā//246//
body.translated_text: 'The wombs of pregnant women are severely pressed. The people, beset by famine and calamity, survive in only one-third.' //246//

body.text:
358.015. mahātmānaśca rājānaḥ śrīmantaśca narottamāḥ/
358.016. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//247//
body.translated_text: 'Great-souled kings, prosperous ones, and the best of men — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.' //247//

body.text:
358.017. mṛgaśīrṣe caledbhūmiroṣadhīnāṃ vināśanam/
358.018. cikitsakāḥ śrotriyāśca ghaṭakāḥ somayājakāḥ//248//
body.translated_text: 'When the earth quakes in <s>Mṛgaśīrṣa</s>, there is destruction of herbs. Physicians, Vedic scholars, astrologers, and <s>Soma</s>-sacrificers —' //248//

body.text:
358.019. somapītāśca ye viprā vānaprasthāśca tāpasāḥ/
358.020. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//249//
body.translated_text: '<s>Soma</s>-drinking <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, forest-dwellers, and ascetics — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.' //249//

body.text:
358.021. ārdrāyāṃ calitā bhūmirvṛkṣā naśyanti kṣīriṇaḥ/
358.022. annapānāni naśyanti pathikā daṃṣṭripālikāḥ//250//
body.translated_text: 'When the earth quakes in <s>Ārdrā</s>, milk-bearing trees perish. Food and drink perish. Travelers, keepers of fanged beasts —' //250//

body.text:
358.023. kūpakhāḥ parikhākhāśca pāpakā ye ca taskarāḥ/
358.024. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//251//
body.translated_text: 'Well-diggers, moat-diggers, wicked ones, and thieves — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.' //251//

body.text:
358.025. punarvasau caledbhūmirmaṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍikāpi ca/
358.026. vāgurikāḥ kāraṇḍavāścakriṇaḥ śukasārikāḥ//252//
body.translated_text: 'When the earth quakes in <s>Punarvasu</s>, a circular region and even a pitcher — trappers, <s>kāraṇḍava</s> ducks, <s>cakriṇas</s> (wheel-makers), parrots, and <s>sārikā</s> birds —' //252//

body.text:
358.027. arbhakā bhramakārāśca māṃsikāḥ śaṅkhavāṇijāḥ/
358.028. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ//253//
body.translated_text: 'Children, jugglers, butchers, and conch-shell traders — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.' //253//

body.text:
358.029. puṣyeṇa ca caled bhūmirbrāhmaṇā nāyakāstathā/
358.030. dūraṃgamā vāṇijakāḥ sārthavāhāśca ye narāḥ//254//
body.translated_text: 'When the earth quakes in <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> and leaders likewise, far-traveling merchants and caravan-leaders —' //254//

body.text:
359.001. <359>pārthivāḥ pārvatīyāśca ye ca tadbhaktigocarāḥ/
359.002. ete vyasanamarcchanti bhūmicālavicālitāḥ/
359.003. śilāvarṣaṃ pravarṣanti śasyānāmanayo mahān//255//
body.translated_text: 'Kings, mountain-dwellers, and those devoted to their service — all these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes. Hail-storms rain down; great is the destruction of crops.' //255//

body.text:
